turns.text: How will people receive the truth that I have to offer?
turns.zh: 人们会怎么接受我不得不说的真相呢？

turns.text: So, you know, I'm in that same place with, with this book.
turns.zh: 所以，你知道吧，我写这本书的时候也是同样的处境。

turns.text: My hope is that people will find something useful in it.
turns.zh: 我希望人们能在书里找到一些有用的东西。

turns.text: And I have been, I've spent my time alone with this book, talking with myself and with the few people that I've let look at it.
turns.zh: 而且我一直，我花时间独自面对这本书，和自己对话，也和少数几个我允许看这本书的人聊。
现在我要把这些想法分享出来了。
它们能和人产生连接吗？
